referral.message: Ophthalmic referral assessment was deferred because the submitted fundus image was inadequate for reliable automated analysis.
referral.threshold: Referral assessment requires successful image analysis

xai.interpretation: Explainability analysis was not performed because image quality was inadequate.
xai.clinicalLimitation: Grad-CAM is a coarse class-level explanation and is not a lesion segmentation or independent diagnostic method.

clinicalMessage: The submitted fundus image is of inadequate quality for reliable automated screening. Please recapture the image under appropriate acquisition conditions.
disclaimer: This system is an AI-assisted diabetic retinopathy screening prototype and is not a medical diagnostic device. The output should not replace comprehensive ophthalmic examination, clinical judgment, or professional medical advice.
explanationNote: Grad-CAM provides a coarse visual explanation of image regions contributing to the model prediction. It should not be interpreted as a pixel-level lesion segmentation or definitive anatomical localization.
annotationNote: IDRiD expert annotations are used for development and validation of retinal lesion and structure analysis, but are not required during inference on a new patient image.

system.pipeline: Image Quality -> DR Classification -> Referral Assessment -> Grad-CAM
